annotations.title: About Yellowhead and the free Diagnostic

description: Describes Yellowhead Digital, with no sign-in needed: what it is; the free Diagnostic (the ten pillars it checks, how long it takes, what the Free plan includes, and that an account is needed to run one); every plan with its price and monthly Diagnostics; the paid scans and human services with their prices and public pages; and a link that opens the Diagnostic form with a website and business name filled in. Fits questions about what Yellowhead does or costs, whether it checks something, or how to get started, including before any account exists. The optional url and business_name only fill in that link: nothing is scanned, stored or looked up.

business_name.description: Optional. The business name to prefill in the start link, as the person gave it.

url.description: Optional. The website to prefill in the start link, as the person gave it.
